articles.title: CRRC Times Electric Expands High-Power IGBT Module Production Capacity
articles.summary: CRRC Times Electric announces significant expansion of IGBT module manufacturing capacity to meet growing demand from rail transit and EV markets.
articles.content: CRRC Times Electric has announced a major expansion of its high-power IGBT module production capacity. The investment will increase annual production capacity by 50%, addressing the growing demand from rail transit, new energy vehicles, and industrial applications. The expanded facility will feature advanced automation and quality control systems to maintain CRRC's high reliability standards.

articles.title: New 6500V IGBT Module Series for High-Speed Rail Applications
articles.summary: CRRC introduces new 6500V IGBT module series designed specifically for high-speed rail traction applications.
articles.content: CRRC Times Electric has launched a new series of 6500V IGBT modules targeting high-speed rail applications. The new modules feature improved switching characteristics and higher reliability for the demanding requirements of 350km/h+ train operations. Initial customer evaluations have shown excellent performance matching international competitors.
